answer: Plant velvet canaries in each epoch's grove: a few operator-seeded answers that look plausible but are known templates, indistinguishable from real ones. A sybil farm bulk-copying or mutually praising will collide with a canary or grade one highly, and that collision is itself the evidence — the prism of hidden traps refracts the flock's own copying back at it, while an original author, writing from scratch, simply never touches the bait.
